newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tohoku Oil refinery fire put out -- NHK television.
newsitem.headline: Tohoku Oil refinery fire put out -- NHK television.

text.p: A fire at Tohoku Oil Co Ltd's 100,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery on Monday was put out early in the evening, NHK public broadcasting said.
The fire broke out at the company's newly installed fuel oil desulphurisation unit, but there were no casualties and the refinery continued to operate, a spokeswoman said earlier.
The spokeswoman could not be reached for confirmation of the NHK report.
The refinery is the only one operated by Tohoku Oil, which is part of the Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd group.
